scope: New independent infrastructure followup: response acceptance in two existing operator session CLIs; not a physical/business acceptance receipt and not an increase to the original172-unit denominator.
bugs_reproduced: Douyin could PASS with no user/info response or HTTP200 JSON parse failure.
Xiaohongshu never required apiOk, so missing response, malformed JSON, business errors and HTTP errors could still PASS.
A slower earlier successful response could overwrite a later failed account response.
Success-named screenshots were created before the API acceptance gate.
fix: Require an observed HTTP2xx parsed JSON object and the existing affirmative provider business fields. HTTP200 alone is insufficient.
Explicit nonzero status_code/code and explicit success:false cannot be overridden by positive-looking body fields.
Arrival sequence protects the newest account response against older asynchronous body completion.
Missing/failed API receipt exits nonzero, writes only failure screenshot, and does not claim the session expired or ask to rescan merely because API acceptance is missing.
Create success screenshot/PASS only after the response gate. Existing browser cleanup, input names and valid business-success variants remain.

race_red.reason: A slower earlier successful response finished after the newer failure and incorrectly restored PASS before the sequence fix.

fixture_boundary: Each actual Node CLI is copied byte-for-byte into owned scratch and executed as a child. Only Playwright browser transport is synthetic. Child environment contains only fixture storageState values, no inherited secrets; HTTP/HTTPS/fetch hard-reject. No real browser, account profile/cookie, device, QR, platform call, draft creation or alert is executed. Temporary JSON files are synthetic and stay under owned scratch.
unchanged_boundary: The original response URL includes(path) matcher remains. This change does not establish exact provider-origin/path identity; that preexisting limitation was identified by independent review and is not described as fixed. No guessed Xiaohongshu API-host restriction is introduced.

independent_review.result: No blocking issue in this response-acceptance/sequence/cleanup increment; existing origin matching boundary remains explicitly unclaimed.

external_evidence: Six external acceptance gaps remain open. These96 offline tests prove the script predicate/regression contract, not a current authenticated session or physical success.
